description: Every byte source the T10 parser tests read, labelled by what it is evidence of. The official output is a fixture committed by the RASPA authors; it verifies the parser and is never registered as a RAVEL computation. Synthetic outputs are generated in memory by tests/premium/T10/support.py:synthetic_output and are TEST_FIXTURE, used only for failure and convergence branches.

fixtures.note: Unmodified official output. It proves the parser reads RASPA 2.0 format; it does not prove RAVEL executed anything.

generated_test_fixtures.note: A minimal RASPA-shaped file written by the tests to exercise non-convergence, completion, state-point, unit, version and exit-code branches. Never compared to a scientific result.
